title.narrative: Humanitarian-Development-Peacebuilding Nexus Project in Kenya and Ethiopia

description.narrative: ACRE: Accelerating Cooperation and Resilience to tackle natural resource challenges in fragile and conflict affected borderlands, using the Humanitarian-Development-Peacebuilding Nexus This project will be implemented in northern Kenya and southern Ethiopia to improve the adaptive capacity of these drought prone communities and focuses primarily on Marsabit County, the largest ASAL county in Kenya as well as the Nyangatom and Dasenech districts of south Omo in Ethiopia. The geographic locations are selected considering the perennial droughts that these areas experienced by the negative impacts of climate change and due to the frequent escalation of border conflict among the pastoral communities that frequently occur as a result of competition towards the dwindling natural resources. The climate change induced prolonged droughts in the borderland area has led to population displacement, changes in the distribution of resources within society, increased gender inequalities, depleted livelihoods, and increased resources scarcity.
